description: Condensing cmux command output into one short line for the friendly failure message the person sees in the transcript and in Settings → Remote. CR, LF and tab become spaces, runs of spaces collapse to one and leading/trailing spaces go; then, if the result is longer than maxChars characters (Swift Characters: extended grapheme clusters, never bytes or UTF-16 units), it is cut to max(1, maxChars - 1) characters followed by U+2026 …. Display-only: this is not the injection line-break flattener.
function: RemoteControlService.condense(_:maxChars:) — input {text, maxChars} in, condensed string out
verifiedBy: Characterization of the Swift implementation (spec #93, ticket #121); Tests/PowerUpTests/CmuxReportingFixtureTests.swift. Pure function, independent of any cmux version. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/text_safety.rs condense_cases runs text_safety::condense, and checks that a limit of 2 or more is never exceeded.

cases.name: empty input
cases.reason: No output stays empty, so the caller can tell there was no detail.

cases.name: whitespace only collapses to empty
cases.reason: Output that is only blank lines is no detail at all.

cases.name: below the limit unchanged
cases.reason: Short text must not be marked as shortened.

cases.name: exactly at the limit unchanged
cases.reason: Text exactly the limit long fits; it must not lose its last character to a marker.

cases.name: one above the limit
cases.reason: Over the limit the result is limit-1 characters plus …, so the shortened text is exactly the limit long and visibly cut.

cases.name: far above the limit

input.text: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog

cases.reason: Long output must be cut with a clear marker.

cases.name: real limit 200 at 201 characters

input.text: xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx y

cases.expected: xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx xxxxxxxxx…
cases.reason: failureMessage uses 200 for stderr/stdout; one character over is cut to 199 plus the marker.

cases.name: line breaks and tabs collapse to single spaces
cases.reason: Multi-line stderr becomes one readable line; leading/trailing whitespace goes.

cases.name: collapsing happens before measuring
cases.reason: The limit applies to the collapsed text, so padding never forces a cut.

cases.name: CRLF collapses like LF
cases.reason: Windows-style line endings in tool output are also flattened.

cases.name: CJK cut at a character boundary

input.text: 日本語のテキストです

cases.reason: The limit counts characters, not bytes; a 3-byte UTF-8 character is never split.

cases.name: emoji with skin tone counts as one character
cases.reason: A modifier sequence is one user-perceived character and is never cut in half.

cases.name: flag sequence counts as one character
cases.reason: Regional-indicator pairs must not be split into stray letters.

cases.name: ZWJ family counts as one character
cases.reason: A ZWJ sequence is one character; cutting inside it would show broken glyphs.

cases.name: decomposed accent counts as one character
cases.reason: A base letter plus combining mark is one character; the mark is never orphaned.

cases.name: limit of one still shows a character
cases.reason: With a tiny limit at least one character is kept before the marker (the result is then 2 long).

cases.name: limit of zero still shows a character
cases.reason: A zero limit never yields a bare marker.

cases.name: non-breaking space is not collapsed
cases.reason: Only space, tab, CR and LF are whitespace here; other spacing is the tool's own text.

cases.name: U+2028 is not flattened by condense
cases.reason: condense is display-only; injection safety is flattenLineBreaks' job (line-breaks.json), not this function's.

cases.name: a line break a combining mark follows is kept
cases.reason: Foundation's replacement never matches a break that a combining scalar follows, so the break stays (display text only; the injection flattener works on scalars).

cases.name: a space a combining mark follows does not separate
cases.reason: A space with a combining mark is one character that is not a space, so it is not collapsed: only one of the two spaces is a separator.

cases.name: negative limit still cuts
cases.reason: Any text is longer than a negative limit, so it is cut to one character and the marker; callers pass 160 and 200, but every implementation must agree.

cases.name: negative limit on empty text gives only the marker
cases.reason: Even empty text is longer than a negative limit, so the result is the marker alone.
